outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry dot plots (pseudocolor scatter plots) where each point represents an individual cell event; these are scatter-plot type displays, not averaged summary statistics, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
Flow cytometry dot plots showing individual cell events directly as scatter points; no averaging is depicted that would require overlaid individual points.
Flow cytometry gating scatter plots displaying individual cell events; this is raw single-cell data, exempt from the individual-data-points requirement like other scatter plots.
Color-coded overlay of flow cytometry scatter plots (MBC, GC, naive populations), each dot representing an individual cell; not a bar/summary chart requiring point overlay.
Flow cytometry gating scatter plots showing individual cell events with gated percentages; exempt as scatter-plot data rather than an averaged summary chart.
